evidence.decision: Prefers standard meanings and permits custom gestures only for frequent specialized work with a simple explanation, discoverability and a complete explicit alternative.
evidence.artifact: Requires a gesture/action/conflict map and revised interaction artifact, including feedback, unavailable states and reserved-system gesture checks.
evidence.transformation: The spatial editor example replaces a strenuous two-hand shoulder-height dismissal and wrist tools with Close, familiar indirect activation and tools outside reserved overlay space.
evidence.verification: Checks essential gesture-only work, changed navigation meanings, lagging manipulation feedback and overlay conflict; recognition and ergonomics explicitly require real-use/device tests.
evidence.applicability: Differentiates touch, trackpad, indirect/direct spatial input and Watch double-tap container behavior; custom visionOS hand gestures require Full Space and hand-data permission.
evidence.handoffs: Uses Accessibility for alternatives, Pencil for stylus-specific gestures and Eyes for indirect targeting feedback.
evidence.distinctiveness: Predictive manipulation feedback, conflict mapping, spatial palm/wrist reservations and Watch double-tap scroll-versus-primary-action decisions make this more than an article summary.
